clauses.clause: When this creature enters, return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: 'ask target: [opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]' (the opponent's creatures only); each pick 'moves battlefield -> hand (by card/MOVE_ZONE)', 'opp: hand 2 -> 3'. Also fires when it enters on the opponent's turn. Not triggered by other creatures entering.
